cited_checks.note: The attested maximal inequality, with lambda=sqrt(N)x, is exactly the displayed DKW--Massart bound.

The attested Donsker theorem applies to the bounded VC class of half-line indicators; iid cell sampling and fixed finite independent products give the stated independent Brownian-bridge specialization and atom covariance.
The stated Hadamard-differentiable delta-method implication is the sequential normed-space specialization of the attested Theorem 3.9.4.
For the finite-dimensional, hence separable, joint vector used here, the attested a.s.-representation theorem gives the claimed coupling specialization.
